name: Lamiamon
description: (Tag:medium-size)(Tag:poison)(Tag:reptilian)(Character)Lamiamon is a draconic snake-like Digimon specializing in poison mastery but weak in direct confrontation. She synthesizes varied poisons like lethal, melting, paralyzing, and vitality-sapping types where stronger poisons cost more energy and weaken against stronger targets, and can cure some ailments with specialized poisons.
